title: Diallel analysis by Griffing's methods — Griffing
text: Data cell means. plot belongs cross \(\times j\) parents \(\) (female, Cross1) \(j\) (male, Cross2) replicate (block). \(P\) parents \(B\) replicates, cell means form \(P \times P\) matrix \(\mathbf{Y}\) elements \(Y_{ij}\); \(Y_{\cdot}\), \(Y_{\cdot j}\) \(Y_{\cdot\cdot}\) row, column grand totals. four methods differ cells present: Methods 2 4 cross may recorded either way round (Cross1 = 3, Cross2 = 5 reverse); stored lower-numbered parent first. Every cross method must present; individual plots may missing. missing plots cell means least-squares means block analysis (block effects summing zero), removes bias missing plot good poor block cause, \(B\) error variance cell mean harmonic mean numbers plots per cross (exact every cross number plots, approximation otherwise). Model. mean cross \(\times j\) $$Y_{ij} = \mu + g_i + g_j + S_{ij} + R_{ij} + \bar{e}_{ij},$$ gca effects \(\mathbf{g} = (g_1, \ldots, g_P)^\top\), symmetric sca effects \(S_{ij} = S_{ji}\) reciprocal effects \(R_{ij} = -R_{ji}\) (Methods 1 3 ), error variance \(\sigma^2/B\). fixed model (Model = 1) effects constants \(\sum_i g_i = 0\) sca reciprocal effects summing zero array; random model (Model = 2) independent random variables variances \(\sigma^2_g\), \(\sigma^2_s\) \(\sigma^2_r\). Error mean square. plot data analysed randomized complete block design crosses treatments; \(MS_E\) residual mean square \(f_E\) degrees freedom. error line combining-ability table scale cell mean: sum squares \(SS_E/B\), mean square \(\sigma^2_m = MS_E/B\). Sums squares (Griffing 1956; Singh Chaudhary 2004), scale cell means. Method 1: $$SS_g = \frac{1}{2P}\sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{\cdot })^2 - \frac{2}{P^2}Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2, \quad   SS_s = \frac{1}{2}\sum_i\sum_j Y_{ij}(Y_{ij} + Y_{ji}) - \frac{1}{2P}\sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{\cdot })^2   + \frac{1}{P^2}Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2, \quad SS_r = \frac{1}{2}\sum_{<j} (Y_{ij} - Y_{ji})^2,$$ \(P-1\), \(P(P-1)/2\) \(P(P-1)/2\) degrees freedom. Method 2 (totals symmetric table, cross counted two arrays): $$SS_g = \frac{1}{P+2}\left[\sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{ii})^2 - \frac{4}{P}Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2\right], \quad   SS_s = \sum_{\le j} Y_{ij}^2 - \frac{1}{P+2}\sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{ii})^2   + \frac{2}{(P+1)(P+2)}Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2,$$ \(P-1\) \(P(P-1)/2\) degrees freedom. Method 3: \(SS_g = \sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{\cdot })^2/(2(P-2)) - 2Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2/(P(P-2))\), \(SS_s = \frac{1}{2}\sum_{<j}(Y_{ij}+Y_{ji})^2 - \sum_i (Y_{\cdot} + Y_{\cdot })^2/(2(P-2)) + Y_{\cdot\cdot}^2/((P-1)(P-2))\) \(P(P-3)/2\) degrees freedom, \(SS_r\) Method 1.
